text: Reboot the VM. From the guest's journal (`journalctl -b -u NetworkManager`, `-k`) and a oneshot unit ordered `Before=NetworkManager.service` that logs `sysctl net.ipv6.conf.enp1s0.disable_ipv6` (installed for the measurement and removed after), record into `.claude/evidence/2.1/ipv6-boot.txt`: the value before NM starts, after `systemd-sysctl`, and after NM activates enp1s0, plus NM's IPv6 method for the profile (`nmcli -g ipv6.method con show <active>`). Pass: the file names which step set 0. If neither step did, stop and ask; do not guess a mechanism.
why: Live VM boot measurement: .claude/evidence/2.1/ipv6-boot.txt (+ raw-boot.txt), via the QEMU agent; no repo patch can break it.
